Let me look at how the operation is deserialized from the datasource. Let me look at the operation.h for BignumCalc and how it's constructed.

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "BignumCalc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/cryptofuzz/operation.h | head -20 && echo "===" && grep -n "BignumCalc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/cryptofuzz/include/cryptofuzz/operations.h 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜ode>

<function=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>find /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/cryptofuzz -name "*.h" | xargs grep -ln "class BignumCalc" 2>/dev/null</parameter>
